scope: Sanitized historical bounded lab observations; no live connection, client or production acceptance
manual_registry_policy: commands/capabilities/sources retain original documentation classifications and provenance; observations are independent evidence

observations.title: TCP identity, status, T1/T2, OF and ITR
observed: VI/RM/PR/PNR verified; SR/RER/WR/CSR in Run. CSR five digits; PNR field 48 bytes with NUL padding.
Fourteen triggers on a program copy: 13 T2 and one T1. T1 ACK preceded the new RT result. OF,01 detailed response retained padding.
ITR,1 and ITR,1, both returned ER02. Program SR/RER/WR/CSR/BR0/RT returned ER03; VI,1 ER22.
observations.documented_context: IV4 R1.30 manual iv4_82ffe8b0fedc105a PDF 426-446 is newer than this runtime.
limitations: No physical NG, OCR recognition, Through Count, rollover hardware test or production takt acceptance in V1.
Do not interpret VI as unique physical identity; Navigator version differs from sensor firmware.

observations.title: BR binary framing and separate image/result counters
observed: Observed BR uppercase, 22-byte header: BR, + 10 ASCII trigger digits + comma + 7 ASCII length digits + comma; exactly payload bytes, no final CR in samples.
BMP BR0 1280x960 / 3686454 bytes; BR1 640x480 / 921654 bytes. RT/BR counter pairs included 27/1, 38/12, 40/14.
Reconnect VI/PR succeeded after one deliberately interrupted BR transfer.
limitations: No global counter conversion or atomic part/result/image association; do not CR-split binary payload.
Limited reconnect sample is not recovery robustness or streaming FPS evidence.

observations.title: TCP ownership and Navigator-assisted individual restore
observed: Second TCP session displaced first (EOF); second continued. Navigator on a separate connection coexisted.
GUI individual .iv4a restore of a copied program restored its name; re-export differed in six bytes outside name.
limitations: Single socket owner and serial queue are design recommendations, not a universal session limit.
No bit-identical/full sensor restore; .iv4p is not established as configuration backup.

observations.title: TP STR SDR RFC TR and mode-dependent monitoring
observed: Program: VI/RM/PR/PNR/TP/TR responded; SR/RER/WR/CSR/STR/SDR/RFC returned ER03.
Run before first trigger: TP 47.8 degC, SDR 00000 with no SD recognized, RFC 0; STR ER03. After four cycles STR max/min/average 385 ms and triggers/OK 4, NG/errors 0.
PNR fixed field 48 bytes with NUL padding; PNR,1 variable length. TR local clock is not verified UTC.
observations.documented_context: TP/STR/SDR/RFC/TR are documented in IV4 manual, not inferred from IV4-H.
limitations: SDR zero is not percent free and no-card test does not validate live SD capacity.
No saturation/reset/power-cycle statistics test; seven SR fields need model/manual interpretation.

observations.title: Controlled TCP inspection, image and ITR firmware delta
observed: Three T2 and one T1 gave four OK; immediate RT after T1 remained 3, later 4.
BR0 and BR1 returned BMP full/half size; BR/RT both 4 in this sample.
ITR,1 returned 64 spaces on AI Count and AI OCR; ITR,1, returned ER22; VI,1 returned ER22.
limitations: ITR spaces are not recognized OCR text. Older R1.20.05 returned ER02 for both ITR variants.
Matching BR/RT counters in one sequence do not establish atomic pairing.
All six outputs were configured OFF; electrical levels were not measured.

observations.title: PW PNW DW with independent readback
observed: PNW changed a copied program name, PNR readback confirmed it.
DW changed AI Count lower/upper thresholds from 1/1 to 2/2; DR confirmed. Two NG arose over the same image; limits were restored via DW/DR.
PW program switching is recorded with PR readback in the controlled test sequences.
observations.documented_context: PW/PNW/DW formats and persistence constraints: iv4_82ffe8b0fedc105a PDF 430-431.
limitations: Threshold-induced NG is not a physically faulty part.
ACK is not general configuration verification; after timeout outcome can be unknown and mutations must not be blindly retried.
No full tool editor, autonomous catalog/export or startup persistence proof.

observations.title: Typed OPC UA metadata, notifications and methods
observed: Namespace URI urn:KEYENCE:VisionSensor:IV4:OPCUaServer; observed index 2 must be resolved by URI each session.
MachineStatus i=16001 datatype i=3100; MachineInformation i=16002 datatype i=3101; OperationResult i=16500 datatype i=3110. Values CurrentRead; not CurrentWrite in observed session.
Typed decoding worked after registering enum/structure types with asyncua 2.1.0. Four new results 1-4 notified at 100 ms sampling.

RequestTrigger and ChangeThreshold returned [true,0]; subsequent ResultNo 7 / OK and DR readback supported effects. SwitchProgram P001 -> P002 -> P001 returned [true,0], delayed UA readback about 378/372 ms and TCP PR confirmed.
observations.documented_context: Standard IV4 iv4_82ffe8b0fedc105a PDF 410-415; six methods 17001-17006, not inferred H seventh method.
limitations: None/Anonymous is observed lab configuration, not production authorization.
OperationResult thresholds can remain those of the previous inspection; method success is not immediate configuration readback.
No lossless notification or high-load guarantee, no write permission inferred from readable nodes or method browse.
IV4-H duplicate method ID/checksum type anomalies remain unresolved by this standard IV4 runtime.

observations.title: MQTT raw shape, QoS, action readback and retained boundaries
observed: Four results 8-11 corresponded to controlled TCP cycles. ResultLogic is an object with ResultLogic1..8; ExtendedData entries are objects with Data.
Two camera PUBLISH frames observed QoS 1 and retain false; subscriber metadata reporting QoS 2 is not sensor publish evidence.
Trigger action broker ACK alone was outcome_unknown; later TCP RT12/result12 supported effect. Switch actions had later independent PR P002/P001 readback.
New subscriber saw duplicate retained Online connection and no result with result retain disabled. One broker restart sequence later yielded RT13/NG.
limitations: Limited PCAP stopped at size limit, not entire sequence. Duplicate origin unknown.
Broker ACK, QoS2, retained Online and one reconnect do not prove exactly-once execution, fresh inspection, recovery replay or lossless collection.
No IV4 ResultImage field demonstrated; do not import IV4-H MQTT image schema.

observations.title: AI OCR recognized text differs from master; score is not confidence
observed: Master CR was 722336. Three T2 on P002 gave 15-17 OK with detailed RT and MQTT AI_OCR ReadString 722336.
With physical covering leaving 7223, five controlled cycles 19-23 were NG; CR stayed 722336; OCR recognized 7223 and comparison score was 0. Position Adjustment stayed OK with score 90-91.
TCP detailed, first four MQTT NG payloads, FTP TXT, and fifth-cycle typed OPC UA Good notification each documented recognized text in their respective cycles.
One ASCII detailed response was 175 bytes, OCR block 110 bytes: 14-byte prefix + 96-byte text. ITR,1 returned spaces, not OCR.
limitations: Score 0 is not zero OCR confidence. CR is master text, not recognized result.
One motif and five NG cycles do not prove accuracy/robustness or multibyte encoding/stride across all variants.
Protocols were selected in different cycles; not simultaneous proof of OPC UA and MQTT. No general atomic image/result association.

observations.title: FTP received files, incomplete transfer despite RFC and no error
observed: One cycle delivered BMP, IV4P and UTF-16LE BOM/tab-separated TXT; TXT included recognized OCR. Separate FTP/BR BMPs matched bytes in two controlled single-cycle comparisons.
First three later NG cycles completed only 8/9 expected files; one BMP was zero bytes/incomplete. RFC increased 1 -> 4 while RER/WR were 000.
A later single cycle completed 3/3.
observations.documented_context: Manual RFC counts completed configured transfer groups, not individual files/backlog; runtime receiver evidence is an independent completeness check.
limitations: RFC is not server receipt of every file; no-error is not completeness. Cause unresolved, do not assign camera fault.
Track per-file completion and incomplete groups; no lossless/atomic pairing or recovery guarantee.
FTP only: SFTP, backlog/retry/overwrite behavior and production throughput unverified; IV4P is not full configuration backup.

observations.title: Freshness, source time and single TCP owner
observed: UA SourceTimestamp was about one hour ahead of host; MQTT ImagingTime also differed and used colon before milliseconds.
Second TCP session displaced first (EOF) in a bounded test. Research adapter smoke observed transport error, stale cache and fresh VI after reconnect.
limitations: Retain raw time and host receive time separately; no verified UTC/exposure timestamp.
One socket owner/serialized queue is an integration design inference. No full Fleet integration or concurrency/recovery acceptance.

observations.title: Navigator IoT selector and individual OCR restore
observed: IoT selector presented one choice Disable / OPC UA / MQTT. Recorded tests switched between OPC UA and MQTT, not simultaneous operation.
Navigator exported individual P002 .iv4a, imported into empty P003; subsequent T2 RT18 OK with recognized/master 722336.
limitations: Single-select UI is verified; global impossibility of parallel protocols on every model/FW is not established.
GUI_ASSISTED export/import is not autonomous public API. One inspection after import is not complete sensor restore, physical I/O or production acceptance.
Historical final-state documentation is not present device state.
